title: At 12, he sold garbage bags door to door. Today he's worth $6.8 billion.
caption:
At 12, he sold garbage bags door to door. Today he's worth $6.8 billion.

Fired from a software store for closing a sale, he started his own company and sold it for $6M. Then Broadcast.com: bought by Yahoo for $5.7B in stock.

The Mavericks, a 2011 title, 200+ Shark Tank deals, and Cost Plus Drugs: a leukemia drug that cost nearly $10,000 a month, for $47.

Would you have bet on that kid?
